description:
Founding Tech Lead (GrowthBricks)

Are you a hands-on engineer who loves zero-to-one challenges? Do you want to build systems with real context and memory that do more than reason, use tools, and drive actual business outcomes? 

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains, designed to give GTM teams and AI agents a shared business brain. Business context usually gets fragmented across CRMs, documents, dashboards, and people's heads. GrowthBricks brings that context together so agents and people can make decisions and execute effectively across the sales, marketing, and product stack.

About GrowthBricks

GrowthBricks is a shared business brain for GTM teams and AI agents.

It brings together the context that usually lives across CRM, docs, dashboards, tools, and people’s heads: who we sell to, why customers buy, what matters now, what we tried, and what worked. Agents and people use that context to decide what to do next and execute across the GTM stack.

GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains.

About the role

We’re looking for a hands-on Founding Tech Lead to build GrowthBricks from zero.

You’ll work directly with the product founder and own the technical side of the product: architecture, core systems, integrations, and the agent layer.

The core challenge is turning fragmented, changing business context into reliable memory and agent actions across tools and measuring whether those actions actually drive business outcomes.

You’ll write a lot of the early code yourself, make the key technical decisions, and shape the product as we learn what works.

What you’ll work on

  • Design the core architecture: business context, agents, tools, integrations, and feedback loops.
  • Build agentic workflows that can reason over company context and act across CRM, sales, marketing, and product systems.
  • Build context extractors from GTM team artifacts like sales calls, emails, internal documents, CRM state, marketing campaigns, etc.
  • Work on prompting, context management, memory, tool use, and orchestration.
  • Connect GrowthBricks to the existing GTM stack rather than rebuilding everything around it.
  • Decide where to use MCP, APIs, frameworks, or third-party tools and where a custom solution is worth it.
  • Prototype fast, discard weak ideas, and turn the useful ones into product primitives.

We expect that you

  • Are a strong hands-on engineer who enjoys zero-to-one work.
  • Have built with LLMs, agents, or agentic workflows used by real people, and improved them based on failures, evaluations, and user feedback.
  • Understand how context, prompting, tools, and agent behavior fit together.
  • Can design backend systems, APIs, data models, and integrations.
  • Are comfortable making decisions before all the answers are known.
  • Prefer simple, pragmatic solutions over unnecessary complexity.

We’re especially interested if you

  • Have worked in solution engineering, sales engineering, pre-sales, or built software for GTM teams.
  • Understand the modern GTM stack: CRM, enrichment, outbound, automation, and product signals.
  • Have automated sales or marketing workflows, ideally with agents or LLMs.
  • Have owned a technical product from a blank repo to something people actually used.

 

GTM experience is not mandatory, but if you already understand how sales and marketing teams work, that is a strong advantage.

What we offer

  • A competitive salary and strong benefits package.
  • The runway and resources of an established company, with startup-level autonomy.
  • A founding role with direct influence over both product and architecture.
  • Real users and real workflows from day one.
  • Freedom to choose the stack, tools, and technical approach.
  • A chance to help define what an agent-native GTM product should look like.

Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Role Overview

The Senior Campaign Operations Manager is a pivotal role responsible for taking operational delivery across CRM, Promotional Operations and Front-End Content & Merchandising to a new standard, giving the business and senior leadership genuine confidence in what's being built, executed and delivered across every owned channel and touchpoint.

You're hands on enough to troubleshoot live platforms and lead incident response the moment a campaign or promotion needs it, with an eagle-eyed view across everything live and everything coming next. You lead people the same way you lead delivery: coaching the team to raise their own standards, not just directing their work, and setting benchmarks the wider function can build on.

Operating at the intersection of CRM, Operations and Product, this role is central to Fanatics' ambition to become the #1 Online US Casino by 2030. 

Key Responsibilities

Delivery Accountability & Operational Control

  • Hold end-to-end accountability for the operational running of campaign, promotion and front end content delivery across the team, ensuring all requirements from Commercial, Analytics, Product and Engineering are in place from approved brief through build, QA, deployment, monitoring and post-launch review. 
  • Maintain a complete, eagle-eyed view of delivery status, live risk and upcoming critical moments, keeping the campaign calendar, dependencies and escalation paths accurate.
  • Hold the team accountable for quality and timeliness, stepping in directly when delivery or player experience is at risk, and surfacing systemic risk that needs action beyond a single workstream.

Incident Management & Operational Resilience

  • Own on-call coverage and incident response for live campaigns, promotions and content, acting as the senior operational escalation point when delivery or execution risk surfaces.
  • Troubleshoot platform and execution issues hands on, coordinating containment, stakeholder communications, recovery and post incident follow up.
  • Own root-cause resolution, escalating platform-level causes to the CRM & Promotions Enablement Lead where needed and driving corrective action on recurring or high-severity incidents.
  • Establish the severity levels, playbooks and launch monitoring checklists that keep incident response consistent and repeatable.

Standards, Governance & Compliance

  • Set standards for campaign and content setup, audience selection, offer eligibility, testing, deployment and monitoring across owned channels.
  • Own the operational QA and release readiness gate that live activity must clear before launch, in partnership with Commercial, Legal, Compliance and Product, ensuring responsible gaming, privacy and jurisdictional requirements are met with clear audit trails.
  • Maintain the change controls, access permissions and documentation required for consistent, compliant and continuously improving execution.

Team Leadership & Capability Building

  • Lead, coach and develop the team, setting clear objectives, decision rights, performance expectations, and a benchmark for operational excellence that others are equipped to meet.
  • Build capability and confidence across the function through hands-on coaching, playbooks and structured knowledge sharing, rather than direction alone.
  • Create a culture of ownership and continuous improvement, where risks and mistakes are surfaced early and addressed constructively, and close capability or resourcing gaps as they emerge.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with CRM Planning on the campaign roadmap, upcoming plans and capacity signals so operational readiness is built in early.
  • Serve as the critical interface into Customer Support and VIP, briefing them on upcoming activity, equipping them to resolve player escalations, and feeding recurring friction points back into delivery standards.
  • Represent operational readiness and delivery risk in cross functional planning for new campaigns, promotions, content and platform capabilities, connecting operational performance to player experience and business outcomes.

Skills & Experience

Essential: 

  • 6+ years in CRM, campaign or promotional operations, delivery management or lifecycle marketing, including proven experience leading and developing a team.
  • Accountability for high-volume, time-sensitive operational delivery across multiple channels or workstreams in a complex digital consumer business.
  • Hands-on working knowledge of CRM or promotional bonusing platforms (e.g. XtremePush, Braze, Optimove or similar) strong enough to troubleshoot live issues directly and assess technical risk.
  • Proven experience leading incident response, on-call governance or escalation frameworks for live activity, with sound operational judgement under pressure.
  • A track record of designing or improving operational processes, controls, service levels and performance reporting, drawing on workflow management tools (e.g., Airtable, Jira). 
  • Excellent 360° stakeholder management and people leadership, able to influence senior stakeholders across CRM, Product, Compliance, Commercial, Legal, Customer Support and VIP while raising team capability.

Preferred: 

  • Experience in iGaming, sports betting or another regulated, compliance-heavy environment.
  • Knowledge of online casino mechanics, bonusing platforms and player journeys.
  • Working knowledge of SQL or BI tools for operational diagnosis, reporting and performance analysis.
  • Experience operating in Agile or product-led delivery environments, and scaling operational governance or automation in a high-growth organization.

Global Ways of Working & Flexibility

Credit risk framework and pricing Maintain the first-line Credit Risk / Credit Underwriting framework and supporting operating procedures. Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency, consistency and control of the credit process. Risk & Controls Support the ongoing development of Operations risk and control within ClearBank Europe, ensuring operational risks, controls and residual-risk assessments remain current, appropriately evidenced and aligned to risk appetite. Work with risk and control owners to assess inherent risk, control design and effectiveness, and residual risk, providing constructive first-line challenge where required. Maintain oversight of locally operated, Group and outsourced controls, ensuring ClearBank Europe has appropriate evidence and entity-level oversight. Support the management of operational incidents, control weaknesses, issues and remediation actions, ensuring root causes and lessons learned feed back into the RCSA and control environment. What does success in this role look like? Credit assessments and proposals are timely, well evidenced and decision-ready, with a clear audit trail from client information through to conclusion and limit recommendation. Daily EWI monitoring and annual reviews operate reliably, with Watch List, Default, renewal and exit cases identified and progressed without unnecessary delay. The first-line credit framework, models and tools remain practical, current and consistently applied as the lending portfolio develops. Stakeholders have a clear view of case status, responsibilities and next steps because you actively coordinate the credit lifecycle rather than simply completing individual analyses. You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly about the best result for customers, colleagues and the bank. You seek feedback, assume positive intent and build strong, trusting relationships. You care about quality, but you also know that progress matters: you learn, iterate and improve. Expense coverage – Mobile phone allowance and travel cost reimbursement. Family – Enhanced family-friendly leave. Personal development – We offer personal development budgets, opportunities to take part in role-related training and unlimited LinkedIn Learning. And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future Role level: 3 A little bit more about us! As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Ledgy, you'll build the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably. You'll join our Platform team, collaborating with engineers and InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure for a product that helps companies manage equity.

  • Cloud infrastructure. Evolve our GCP and Kubernetes cloud architecture and setup with Terraform, improving reliability, simplicity, and cost visibility and enabling scaling to multiple availability regions.

You'll also join our incident-response on-call rotation during working hours and help prevent recurring issues. As we expand our servicing of public companies and jurisdictions, this on-call might evolve to compensated 24h/7 hour rotation.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. These are the things that would make you an especially good fit.

  • Value collaboration, mentorship, and thoughtful trade-offs between reliability, complexity, and cost

Experience with Node.js, MongoDB or Temporal is a plus.

Our Tech Stack

We work in TypeScript: React, Tailwind CSS, and tRPC on the front end, and tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, and Temporal on the back end. Infrastructure runs on GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, and GitHub Actions. For observability and incident response we use Grafana, Sentry, and PagerDuty.

The role

HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognised as the go-to expert on cost across the team.

 

You will...

  • Develop a harmonised cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.
  • Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.
  • Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalisation and consolidation opportunities.
  • Report progress against the group's ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.

 

You are....

  • An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to scrutiny from Finance and senior leadership.
  • Commercially minded: you look at total value, not just unit price, and you understand what drives cost in food and packaging.
  • A clear communicator who turns complex analysis into a simple story that regional teams can act on.
  • Collaborative: you build alignment with Finance, procurement, and market teams through influence rather than authority.
  • Self-directed: you manage several analyses at once and take ownership from the question through to the recommendation.

 

You have....

  • 5+ years in procurement, cost analysis, or consulting in a global food, retail, or consumer goods business.
  • Hands-on experience building should-cost models or total cost of ownership frameworks, and using them to influence real commercial decisions.
  • Experience measuring cost and savings across multiple markets, including the common pitfalls such as inconsistent methods, inflation effects, and volume mix.
  • Experience with food, ingredient, or packaging categories, including origin, certification, and specification considerations.
  • Fluent in English. Bonus if fluent in French, German, or Dutch. Comfortable working across time zones, with the ability to travel up to 20%.

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with sustainability certification schemes and their cost implications.
  • Experience with commodity price risk or hedging frameworks.

 

What we offer

Compensation & Financial Wellbeing

  • Enjoy 20% off HelloFresh and 40% off Factor_ subscriptions.
  • Access the "Benefits at Work" platform for discounts on brands like Nike, Bol.com, and IKEA. 
  • You'll receive a HelloFresh laptop, a €250 home office setup budget, and contribute to the Bedrijfspensioenfonds Levensmiddelen pension scheme (2025 rate 27.6%; employer pays 19.64%, employee pays 7.96%).

Health & Wellbeing

  • Benefit from discounts on ClassPass and gym memberships via Bedrijfsfitness Nederland, free bootcamp classes (Amsterdam), and free subscriptions to Headspace and OpenUp.
  • Get a 10% discount on additional health insurance at Zilveren Kruis in 2025.

Flexibility & Work-Life

  • Work flexibly with our hybrid setup (50% office, 50% remote), plus a €2.40 daily remote work allowance.
  • Receive 24 days of annual leave (pro-rated), plus one additional day per year of service (up to 30 days total).
  • Full reimbursement for 2nd-class public transport to the office, plus €0.23 per km for car and bicycle travel.
  • Eligible employees can work from another country for up to 8 weeks per year.

Career & Development

  • Grow with our "Learning Never Stops" mindset: participate in Pantry Staple trainings, access internal/external opportunities, and join our cross-market mentoring program.

Culture & Environment

  • Enjoy fresh homemade lunches in the office (€3.00/day), weekly vrij-mi-bo (Friday drinks), quarterly strategy sessions, and team events.

 

We are HelloFresh

At HelloFresh we embrace and welcome diversity and we currently employ over 15,000 individuals globally who contribute to this. We employ individuals based on their ability to perform a job rather than on the basis of their: race, national origin, color, caste, social origin or position, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, political opinion, marital status or any other characteristic. Senior Mechatronic System Architect | Medical Robotics (m/f/d)

Location: Maastricht, Aachen, and Eindhoven region, working mainly on-site with our development partner in Maastricht. Regular travel to Hamburg and to clinical sites, about 2 to 4 days per month.

Reports to: CTO

About the venture: ROB'E

ROB'E is a Hamburg-based medtech startup and part of the NLC Health Ventures portfolio. We are developing a robotic system that holds and steers a standard transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) probe during structural heart interventions. Interventionalists get stable, reproducible echo views, and echocardiographers no longer have to stand next to the patient in the X-ray field.

Our first-generation prototype has been used in a first-in-human study with published results. We are now developing the next generation from scratch as a fully compliant medical device for CE marking and FDA clearance. The team includes a CTO, a System Software Architect and a Head of Quality & Regulatory.

The role

You are the mechatronic design authority of ROB'E. You own the system architecture, the hardware requirements and the technical decisions for the mechanics, drives, sensing and electronics of our robot. You work on site with our engineering development partner in the Maastricht area and steer their team on our behalf. This is a hands-on senior role: you design yourself, review the work of others and make sure the hardware is safe, verifiable and ready for design transfer.

Responsibilities

  • Define and own the mechatronic system architecture: robotic device, drives, force and torque sensing, real-time controllers, safety supervisor, power supply and the interface to commercial TEE probes.
  • Translate user and system requirements into subsystem and interface specifications and keep them traceable through verification.
  • Act as technical counterpart to our engineering development partner, from ideation, technology and part selection through design reviews and approval of design outputs. Challenge cost and effort and make the make-or-buy call per subsystem.
  • Work closely with the System Software Architect on the hardware/software split, real-time control, and safety architecture.
  • Drive the hardware contribution to risk management (ISO 14971), including design FMEA and risk control measures.
  • Plan and lead hardware verification, pre-compliance and full compliance testing for electrical safety and EMC (IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2) with external test houses.
  • Contribute hardware documentation to the design history file and technical documentation under our ISO 13485 quality system.
  • Build prototypes for verification, usability studies and clinical evaluation, together with suppliers and the development partner.
  • Design for cost and manufacturability from the start and prepare the transfer to series production.

What you bring

Must have

  • MSc or PhD in mechatronics, mechanical, electrical or systems engineering.
  • At least 8 years of hardware development experience, including at least 3 years as a system architect or lead engineer.
  • Hands-on development of active medical devices through design controls, from concept to verified design.
  • Practical experience with IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2 and ISO 14971, and working knowledge of ISO 13485 and MDR.
  • Strong background in motion systems: drives, transmissions, encoders, force/torque sensing and motion safety.
  • Experience steering external engineering partners or suppliers, including technical reviews and cost control.
  • Fluent in English and comfortable working in a small, fast moving startup team.

Nice to have

  • Experience with medical robotics, catheter or endoscope handling, or image guided intervention systems.
  • Knowledge of cleanable and reprocessable device design and single use interface components.
  • Dutch or German language skills.

What we offer

  • A key role in a clinically validated medtech venture, with real influence on the product and the company.
  • Close collaboration with interventional cardiologists and direct exposure to the cath lab.
  • Permanent employment with a competitive salary and an employee stock option plan.
  • A lean, senior team with short decision paths.

Why Join ROB’E?

  • Build a category-defining MedTech company from an early stage
  • Work directly with experienced physician-founders
  • Take ownership across strategy, product, and company building
We would love to hear from exceptional individuals who are excited about building a company at the intersection of AI, robotics, and cardiovascular medicine.

description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join the team building and operating Nebius Data Platform — a distributed storage and a processing platform that acts as the company’s “source of truth” and the backbone of many internal (and some external) products.
Nebius Data Platform is a single multi-tenant ecosystem based on YTsaurus — instead of running separate HDFS/Kafka/HBase-style systems, we provide storage, compute, and analytics capabilities inside one platform.

We operate across data centers worldwide, running YTsaurus in dedicated Kubernetes clusters with Kubernetes operators and supporting services written primarily in Go. We maintain our own Nebius distribution, develop functionality across the core and platform services, and contribute upstream where it makes sense. This gives us the ability to take improvements from design through implementation to production.

At scale today, this includes ~500 servers, ~20k CPU cores and ~10 PB of compressed data in our largest production cluster, supporting workloads ranging from business-critical pipelines and financial transactions to large-scale ML/LLM training datasets and compute.
As an SRE, you’ll combine software engineering with production ownership: understand how the platform behaves, identify what limits its reliability and growth, and build lasting improvements alongside the developers and teams who use it.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own and improve the reliability, performance, and capacity of our YTsaurus clusters, with particular attention to data durability and predictable behavior under load.

  • Develop services, Kubernetes automation, and operational tooling in Go to simplify cluster provisioning, upgrades, and maintenance.

  • Improve monitoring, alerting, and diagnostic tools so we can detect problems early and understand their impact on users.

  • Investigate failures across Linux, networking, Kubernetes, and distributed storage and compute. Participate in on-call, lead incident investigations, and turn findings into lasting fixes.

  • Improve resource utilization and workload isolation as the platform grows and serves more teams.

  • Work with platform developers and users to make architectural decisions, deliver changes safely, and reduce repetitive operational work.

We expect you to have:

  • Experience operating distributed, stateful systems in production and taking responsibility for their reliability.

  • Strong Linux and networking fundamentals, including the ability to investigate resource bottlenecks and failures beyond the application layer.

  • Practical Kubernetes experience: deploying, operating, and troubleshooting production workloads.

  • Strong programming skills and experience building maintainable software. We primarily use Go; experience in another language and a willingness to learn Go are welcome.

  • A systematic approach to troubleshooting, using evidence from logs, metrics, traces, and system behavior.

  • The ability to drive improvements from problem identification through delivery, communicate trade-offs clearly, and collaborate with developers and platform users.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience with Big Data systems (YTsaurus/Hadoop/Spark/ClickHouse/Kafka-like ecosystems).

  • Experience developing Kubernetes operators or controllers.

  • Experience with performance analysis, capacity planning, or resource management in multi-tenant systems.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

Server Infrastructure is a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team responsible for the full lifecycle of Nebius Cloud hardware: from newly delivered bare metal through provisioning, operation, maintenance, and decommissioning. Almost every Nebius service runs on servers within our domain. Our mission is to make the hardware layer fast, reliable, and invisible.

We apply software engineering to infrastructure operations. We build services and automation that bring servers into the cloud, keep them healthy, recover them from failures, and retire them safely. Our work spans CPU and GPU platforms, the base GNU/Linux system, and the infrastructure supporting our hardware fleet.

As a Senior / Staff Engineer, you’ll take ownership of complex infrastructure challenges and help shape the team’s technical direction. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with architecture, mentoring, and coordination across teams, turning operational needs into reliable services and automation.
You’ll work closely with data center engineers, capacity managers, cloud compute developers, networking teams, and hardware suppliers. Your work will directly affect the reliability and capacity of the entire cloud platform.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Design, build, and operate services for netboot, provisioning, maintenance, automated recovery, and decommissioning.
  • Lead technical initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation and production operation.
  • Help shape the technical roadmap, balancing reliability improvements, new hardware integration, and long-term engineering work.
  • Define meaningful reliability indicators and service level objectives, using them to guide engineering priorities.
  • Reduce operational toil by turning recurring failures and manual procedures into reliable automation.
  • Improve on-call practices, incident response, and learning through blameless incident reviews.
  • Strengthen fleet observability, alerting, testing, deployment safety, and operational readiness.
  • Drive support for new CPU and GPU platforms and improvements to the base GNU/Linux system.
  • Mentor engineers, provide thoughtful design and code reviews, and help the team develop sound engineering practices.
  • Coordinate delivery across teams, communicate technical tradeoffs, and resolve dependencies.
We expect you to have:
  • Strong software engineering experience in Go and a solid understanding of Linux systems.
  • Experience designing, building, and operating infrastructure services, including distributed systems and failure handling.
  • A track record of owning complex technical initiatives and bringing them into production.
  • Practical knowledge of SRE principles: service level objectives, observability, incident management, capacity planning, and toil reduction.
  • Sound technical judgment and the ability to guide architecture and investigate difficult production problems.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices through collaboration and technical example.
  • Clear communication and the ability to work effectively across engineering and operational teams.

We welcome candidates at senior and staff levels. The scope of ownership and technical influence will reflect your experience.
Experience with hardware provisioning, bare metal infrastructure, GPU platforms, or large server fleets would be valuable.
Familiarity with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, GitOps, SaltStack, and Terraform is also useful.
We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

description: Mobileye is looking for a passionate Systems Software Developer to join the Operating System Team in the EyeQ Platform Software Group. While many work on Linux, we work in Linux. Our team is responsible for the core OS DNA of the EyeQ computer vision SoC, defining how the system starts, is composed, and manages its lifecycle in a high-performance automotive environment. We are looking for an experienced systems engineer to join our Core Distribution team. The center of this role is the Linux userspace and the distribution itself: boot and service bring-up, root filesystem composition, and the integration of external SDK into that platform. You will also build Python-based deployment tooling so the OS and SDK stack can be provisioned reproducibly - infrastructure and tool development in service of the OS. What will your job look like: Architect and develop Linux userspace and service bring-up so the distribution boots into a consistent, operational platform under embedded constraints. Enable and integrate an SDK into the OS image - drivers, libraries, runtimes, and filesystem layout as first-class distribution components. Own distribution composition, including packages, sysroots, and image features that make the SDK and core OS a maintainable, versioned platform. Develop Python-based deployment tooling to provision targets with a reproducible OS + SDK environment (image delivery, flashing, and environment setup). Debug at the OS boundary - init/service failures, library and ABI mismatches, missing dependencies, and SDK/runtime issues on the target. Perform root cause analysis on system-level failures in the distribution, from boot and userspace bring-up through a fully operational stack. Collaborate on board bring-up, tailoring the distribution and SDK integration to new EyeQ generations and related target hardware. All you need is: Outstanding graduate in Computer Science or similar field. 5+ years of experience in Embedded Linux development, with a focus on systems software, userspace, or distribution work. Strong C/C++ skills and a solid understanding of POSIX APIs, libraries, and how userspace talks to the kernel. Deep knowledge of Linux Internals, specifically the boot process (Bootloaders, Kernel hand-off, Init systems) and root filesystem layout. Hands-on experience with Embedded Linux Distributions (e.g., custom Yocto recipes, Buildroot, or Linux-from-scratch). Experience enabling vendor SDKs or BSP stacks on Linux — integrating third-party drivers, runtimes, and userspace components into a custom image. Proficiency in debugging tools like GDB, Valgrind, strace, and perf. Experience with Python for infrastructure and tool development — deployment, packaging, and environment setup. Nice to have: Background in Automotive Software. Experience with GPU/accelerator compute stacks (driver + userspace runtime, inference/compute libraries, cross-sysroot workflows). Familiarity with reading hardware schematics and reasoning about basic hardware interfaces and signal. Mobileye changes the way we drive, from preventing accidents to semi and fully autonomous vehicles. Our Mission 

At constellr, we use thermal intelligence from space to understand what is happening on Earth – where, when and at scale. Our satellite constellation delivers high-resolution land surface temperature data, giving governments, defence organisations, commercial operators and global institutions the intelligence they need to monitor change, assess risk and make better-informed decisions.

From national security and critical infrastructure to agriculture and climate resilience, constellr turns temperature into actionable intelligence for a changing world.

Your Role

We are looking for a proactive and detail-driven team player to join our Product and Quality Assurance (PQA) team, with a strong focus on Flight Software Product Assurance.

In this role, you will play a critical part in ensuring the quality, safety, and reliability of both flight and ground software across our growing satellite constellation. You will work at the intersection of engineering, quality, and operations, helping to shape how we build and deliver software in a fast-moving, mission-critical space environment.

The PQA team defines and maintains the company’s quality and Product Assurance standards. Your work will directly contribute to ensuring our software meets the highest levels of robustness, compliance, and reliability, supporting mission success in both orbit and ground operations.

This is a role for someone who thrives in complex, technical environments, enjoys working across disciplines, and is comfortable balancing structured quality processes with the pace of a rapidly scaling space organisation. You will be trusted to take end-to-end ownership, bring clarity to ambiguity, and help embed strong engineering discipline across the software lifecycle.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve a robust Software Product Assurance (PA) programme, reporting directly to the Product Assurance Manager.

  • Take end-to-end ownership of Software Product Assurance across both flight and ground software for our satellite constellation.

  • Ensure rigorous application of software configuration management and release processes, maintaining strong version control, traceability, and engineering discipline.

  • Enforce compliance with safety-critical and mission-critical software standards, with a strong focus on risk reduction and failure prevention.

  • Define and oversee software testing, verification, and validation strategies across all development and delivery phases.

  • Investigate, manage, and resolve software anomalies throughout development, testing, integration, and operational phases.

  • Support Spacecraft Assembly, Integration and Testing (AIT) activities, ensuring software readiness and compliance at every stage.

  • Coordinate and lead software deliveries from suppliers, ensuring alignment with internal standards, schedules, and quality expectations.

  • Participate in subcontractor reviews and key technical meetings, working closely with procurement engineers and Product Assurance stakeholders.

  • Balance the demands of rapid development cycles with the need to maintain strong Product Assurance and software quality standards in a fast-paced space environment.

Job requirements

About you 

Required: 

  • Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related scientific discipline.

  • Proven experience in Flight Software Product Assurance within the space industry.

  • Strong understanding of software testing, verification, and validation in safety-critical environments.

  • Experience with embedded flight software for satellites, spacecraft platforms, or payload systems (experience with FDIR highly desirable).

  • Strong proficiency in software configuration management tools and processes.

  • Familiarity with ECSS standards, particularly ECSS-Q-ST-80C (Software Product Assurance) and ECSS-E-ST-40C (Software Engineering).

  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with experience in risk management and anomaly investigation.

  • Ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines, with a proactive approach to risk identification and escalation.

  • Strong team mindset, with a desire to help build and shape a growing organisation.

  • Comfortable working independently, taking ownership and delivering in a fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

Nice to Have: 

  • Experience with automation, scripting, or AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g. prompt-based workflows).

  • Exposure to high-growth or start-up aerospace environments.

  • Broader understanding of end-to-end spacecraft systems engineering lifecycles.

Why join constellr?

  • High-Impact National Security Mission: Be part of an ambitious mission to launch the world’s first commercial thermal infrared constellation, delivering sovereign-grade "behavioural" intelligence from space to close critical blind spots for defence, intelligence, and maritime surveillance agencies.
  • Fast-Paced "New Space" Innovation: Work at the leading edge of a rapidly evolving defence sector. By leveraging modern, agile New Space methodologies, you will help design, build, and deploy dual-use thermal payloads into operational orbit at a speed and scale that traditional aerospace models simply cannot match.
  • Broad Interdisciplinary Exposure: Accelerate your professional growth by collaborating daily with a diverse, international cohort of astrophysicists, software developers, and defence-system engineers.
  • Inclusive & Scientific Culture: Join a high-trust team deeply committed to diversity, inclusion, and scientific excellence, where academic curiosity is paired with high autonomy and a flat hierarchy.
  • Financial Upside & Well-being: Benefit from a Virtual Share Option Plan (VSOP) for permanent employees, giving you a true stake in the company's growth, alongside highly flexible hybrid working models.

description:
About Us

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

 

About the Team

Fanatics Markets is the real-money prediction and trading app where you can invest in moments you care about. Built on a secure platform, we let users predict real-world outcomes and trade on events they actually follow—from sports and entertainment to political elections and beyond. Our mission is to redefine how fans engage with the moments and markets that matter most. We're looking for the right people to help us build the future of prediction markets.

Role Overview

As a Staff Software Engineer within our Platform team, you will help define the technical direction of the platform underpinning our exchange and trading systems. You will lead the design and evolution of our infrastructure and platform standards to support a highly available, low-latency exchange, partnering closely with exchange engineers and engineering leads to enable rapid innovation without compromising stability or security.

This role requires a balance of deep hands-on software engineering, systems thinking and technical leadership. You will lead complex projects that support the exchange—from load-testing environments and mock integrations to monitoring and automated recovery. You will turn ambiguous requirements into practical designs, own delivery from ideation to production and help operate the platform as the exchange goes live. The balance of coding and infrastructure work varies by project, but you should be comfortable independently developing new software as well as improving existing systems, setting platform standards and mentoring engineers across experience levels.

On the engineering side, we are pioneering the use of AI as a code collaborator. We need engineers who have moved beyond experimentation—who actively use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot to ship production code faster while maintaining exceptional quality.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and development of software tools, services and automation that solve complex infrastructure, reliability and developer experience challenges.
  • Define and evolve the architecture of highly available cloud-native infrastructure, balancing performance, reliability, security and cost as the platform grows.
  • Set technical direction for CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling, remaining hands-on in delivering improvements to the software delivery lifecycle.
  • Lead the development of load-testing environments and supporting software, including mock services and integrations.
  • Establish and evolve standards for AI-augmented development, using effective prompting and validation practices to increase velocity without sacrificing code quality.
  • Identify and mitigate AI-generated code pitfalls, such as security vulnerabilities or over-abstraction, and help teams evaluate the impact on quality and productivity.
  • Guide the design and implementation of platform security safeguards and compliance standards to protect the integrity of the firm’s systems.
  • Shape the system observability roadmap and lead improvements to monitoring, tracing, alerting and automated recovery.
  • Partner with exchange, product and engineering leads to resolve architectural trade-offs, align priorities and deliver scalable platform solutions.
  • Mentor engineers across experience levels, lead technical design discussions and raise engineering standards across teams.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation, lead incident response for team-owned services and drive engineering improvements that prevent recurring incidents.

Skills

  • Significant experience in software, backend or platform engineering, with a track record of leading complex technical projects and delivering production software and scalable, cloud-native environments.
  • Deep software development expertise, including the ability to independently design, build, test and deploy services or substantial tools from scratch and guide others through complex implementation decisions.
  • Deep hands-on Kubernetes experience, including designing and operating production environments, troubleshooting complex failures, and establishing patterns for high availability and efficient scaling.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS and infrastructure as code using Terraform, including making architectural decisions across complex environments.
  • High proficiency in Java and Python; Go is a plus. You should be comfortable bridging the gap between infrastructure and application logic.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems and the ability to make and explain trade-offs between low latency, high availability, scalability and operational complexity.
  • Experience shaping CI/CD and observability approaches, with hands-on knowledge of tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or Datadog.
  • Strong proficiency in using AI collaborators such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot to ship production code and improve engineering workflows.
  • Ability to evaluate AI-generated code for security gaps or architectural errors and establish rigorous testing and validation practices.
  • Proven ability to turn ambiguous problems into a clear technical direction and deliver improvements across team boundaries, balancing immediate needs with long-term architectural health.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical decisions, influence without formal authority and collaborate effectively with distributed engineering and product teams.
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and building alignment around technical standards and architectural decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in high-growth startup environments.
  • Experience with financial systems, exchanges, real-money transactions or regulatory compliance.
  • Background in designing and building internal developer platforms, tools, CLI applications or infrastructure automation services.
  • Experience developing load-testing environments, mock services or automated recovery systems.
  • Experience leading technical initiatives spanning multiple teams or evolving platform architecture through significant growth or change.

Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.

Ready to build the future of sports betting? If you possess some of these skills but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply! Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position. We are open to fully remote candidates based in the United Kingdom. Remote employees may also be eligible for a home office setup stipend.

description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, installer, updater, device APIs, and enterprise DLP support. 

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. The role will lean on your Windows expertise, but projects may have a cross-platform component. This role will include development of features for Firefox in enterprise environments especially implementation of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) features. As a Staff Software Engineer, you’re a clear communicator and expert in your domain, ready to work on multi-month projects. You’ll contribute to the team through code review, mentoring, and discussion.

What you’ll do: 

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Lead projects that improve the stability, security, and performance of Firefox.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring: 

  • 7+ years of overall software engineering experience.
  • Experience with desktop application development on Windows with C++.
  • Advanced knowledge of C and C++ and a solid understanding of assembly language such as x64, x86, or arm64.
  • Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Welcoming differences
    • Being relationship-minded
    • Practicing responsible participation
    • Having grit

Bonus Points for experience with:

  • Enterprise DLP development or deployment
  • Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission.  We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

description: Waarom pak je in de supermarkt het ene product wel uit het schap en het andere niet? Ligt het aan de verpakking? De prijs? Smaak? Gemak? Of simpelweg omdat het precies op de juiste plek staat? Bij Growy telen we verse sla, kruiden en microgreens in Amsterdam in onze vertical farm. Vertical farming klinkt misschien ingewikkeld, maar het idee is simpel: we telen planten in lagen boven elkaar, midden in de stad en helemaal los van het weer buiten. Nu onze producten in steeds meer Nederlandse supermarkten te vinden zijn, willen we onze consumenten nóg beter leren begrijpen. Daarom zoeken we een nieuwsgierige en commercieel ingestelde stagiair die zich wil verdiepen in consumentengedrag en inzichten kan vertalen naar echte commerciële kansen. En nee, dit wordt geen stageproject wat ergens in een lade verdwijnt en niemand ooit nog bekijkt, jouw stage gaat voor ons echt een verschil maken! 🌱Wat ga je doen? Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat meer consumenten Growy ontdekken, proberen én opnieuw kopen? Tijdens je stage ga je bijvoorbeeld: consumenten interviewen en/of focusgroepen organiseren; onderzoeken wat mensen belangrijk vinden bij het kopen van verse salades en kruiden; ontdekken welke drempels consumenten ervan weerhouden een product te proberen; onderzoeken wat juist zorgt voor een herhaalaankoop; kijken naar kansen rondom prijs, assortiment, verpakking, positionering, promoties en zichtbaarheid; kwantitatief onderzoek, zoals enquêtes, opzetten om ideeën te testen; jouw inzichten vertalen naar concrete commerciële en marketingaanbevelingen. Aan het einde van je stage presenteer je jouw belangrijkste inzichten en aanbevelingen aan ons Sales & Marketing team. En als het binnen je stage past, kun je misschien zelfs één van je ideeën in de praktijk testen. De precieze inhoud stemmen we af op de duur van je stage en de eisen vanuit jouw opleiding. Goed om te weten; onze farm is nog volop in ontwikkeling, we zitten nog in onze start-up/scale-up fase. Dit betekent dat je naast je onderzoek ook tijd zult besteden aan andere zaken in onze farm. Dit geldt niet alleen voor jou als stagiair maar voor ons hele team. Zo draait iedereen uit kantoor maandelijks een shift in de farm, waarbij we helpen met zaaien, oogsten of verpakken. 🌱Wat kun je van ons verwachten? Een unieke stageplek; wij bouwen aan de toekomst van voedselproductie; Je wordt onderdeel van een klein team, er wordt naar je ideëen en input geluisterd; We werken fulltime vanaf onze farm in Amsterdam; Een maandelijkse stagevergoeding van 500 euro, we vergoeden geen andere zaken; Veel ruimte en tijd voor creativiteit en een ‘ga het maar proberen!' mentaliteit Een gezellige werksfeer waarin we graag samen na werk nog leuke dingen ondernemen 🌱Wat breng jij? description: Wil je zien wat jouw ideeën doen voor een merk waar jonge ouders dol op zijn? Bij Petite Amélie zie je meteen het resultaat van je werk. Je zet bijvoorbeeld een samenwerking op met een Nederlandse influencer, of je bouwt een landingspagina voor een campagne, en je ziet direct wat het oplevert. Je haalt bij ons niet alleen koffie: vanaf dag één draai je volwaardig mee in ons marketing- & e-commerceteam, met de Nederlandse en Belgische markt als jouw terrein. Over Petite Amélie Wij ontwerpen en produceren meubels, accessoires en speelgoed voor baby- en kinderkamers, en jonge ouders in heel Europa zijn er dol op. We groeien snel, met webshops in Nederland, België, Frankrijk, Duitsland en het Verenigd Koninkrijk. Vanuit ons kantoor in Weesp (15 minuten met de trein vanaf Amsterdam Centraal) werken we met zo’n 30 collega’s aan het merk. Wat ga je doen? Ons team beheert de webshops en alle online kanalen. Organische groei en sterke content staan centraal. Je kiest samen met je begeleider waar je de nadruk op legt, op basis van je leerdoelen en interesses: Influencers & samenwerkingen: je zoekt passende influencers en contentmakers in Nederland en België en neemt zelf contact met ze op. Je zet samenwerkingen op, zoals productgifting, contentdeals en campagnes, en je onderhoudt de relaties. Content & social: je maakt content voor Instagram, TikTok en Pinterest en doet community management. Campagnes & landingspagina’s: je helpt campagnes uitvoeren en bouwt en werkt aan pagina’s die converteren. Webshop & merchandising: je bepaalt mee hoe producten in de shop worden gepresenteerd. SEO & CRO: je zoekt uit waarom bezoekers wel of niet kopen, en wat we daaraan kunnen verbeteren. Data & onderzoek: je rapporteert over e-commerce-KPI’s en doet marktonderzoek naar nieuwe kansen. Aan het eind van je stage heb je echte resultaten en een eigen netwerk om te laten zien, en daarmee val je bij je volgende werkgever meteen op. Wie zoeken we? Dit heb je echt nodig: Je studeert bedrijfskunde, marketing, communicatie, economie of iets vergelijkbaars, op hbo- of wo-niveau, en je stage is onderdeel van je opleiding (met stageovereenkomst). Je bent fulltime beschikbaar voor minimaal 6 maanden, vanaf januari of februari 2027. Je woont in Nederland. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands, en je Engels is goed. Dit maakt je een goede match: Je pakt dingen zelf op, bent nieuwsgierig en denkt commercieel. Je vindt het leuk om mensen te benaderen en relaties op te bouwen. Je hebt oog voor design, interieur en esthetiek. Je werkt nauwkeurig en graag samen. Herken je jezelf niet in elk punt? Solliciteer toch. Enthousiasme en leergierigheid wegen voor ons zwaar. Stuur je CV en vertel ons kort wie je bent. Je kunt een motivatie schrijven, maar je mag jezelf ook voorstellen met een reel, story of een ander creatief format. Dat vinden we leuk, maar het is niet verplicht. Zo verloopt het: binnen een week hoor je van ons. Daarna volgt een (video)kennismaking met je toekomstige begeleider, en je hoort snel of je in januari of februari kunt starten. Vragen? description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Please note: this position is only available for students who are proficient in the Dutch language!  

Bij WPP Media zijn we het wereldwijde mediacollectief van WPP, volledig gebouwd voor het AI-tijdperk. We bundelen het beste platform, de meest getalenteerde mensen en de sterkste partners om innovatieve oplossingen te creëren. Ons doel? Merken elke dag ongeëvenaarde groei bieden. Dit fundament vinden we in onze gedeelde kernwaarden:

We’re Extraordinary: We verleggen grenzen, dagen het gewone denken uit en doorbreken de status-quo in ons streven naar innovatie en groei.

We’re Open: We bouwen vertrouwen en begrip door naadloos samen te werken – met onze teams, klanten en partners.

We’re Optimistic: Een 'growth mindset' zit in ons DNA. We omarmen verandering als dé manier om het beste uit onszelf te halen.

Klaar om de social media-wereld te veroveren? Word onze Stagiair Social Media bij StudioM!

Droom jij ervan om te werken voor A-merken als Mentos, Katja en Tempo-Team? Krijg jij energie van het creëren van viral content en het spotten van de nieuwste TikTok-trends? Dan hebben we de perfecte match! Bij StudioM, het creatieve hart van WPP Media, zoeken we een gedreven Stagiair Social Media die ons team komt versterken.

Wie zijn wij?

StudioM is een uniek collectief van creatievelingen die verslaafd zijn aan digital design, contentcreatie en influencer marketing. We zijn onderdeel van WPP Media en werken vanuit die basis voor de gaafste merken. Je komt terecht in ons jonge, dynamische en supergezellige social media team. Verwacht flexibele kantoordagen, legendarische teamuitjes en een sfeer waar jouw input écht telt.

Jouw missie, mocht je die accepteren:

Als Stagiair Social Media ben jij de motor achter de online aanwezigheid van onze klanten. Je mond dichthouden? Geen optie! We willen jouw frisse ideeën.

  • Content is King (or Queen): Je werkt mee aan ijzersterke contentkalenders en strategieën.
  • Trendspotting: Jij bent onze ogen en oren online. Je weet wat er speelt in de community, welke trends booming zijn en hoe we daarop kunnen inspelen.
  • Community Love: Je helpt mee met het managen van de social communities en bent de stem van het merk.
  • Create & Activate: Je brainstormt mee over de vetste activaties en campagnes die engagement door het dak laten gaan.
  • Data-Driven: Je duikt in de data om insights te vinden die onze strategieën nóg slimmer maken.

Dit ben jij (toch?):

Jij bent allesbehalve een muurbloempje. Social media is jouw natuurlijke habitat en je schermtijd bewijst dat.

  • Je ademt social media, kent alle ins en outs van TikTok en Instagram en wordt wild van het creëren van nieuwe content.
  • Je hebt een proactieve, ‘hands-on’ mentaliteit. Een nieuwe update of trend? Jij ziet kansen en wilt meteen aan de slag.
  • Je bent creatief, zelfstandig en leergierig (HBO-denkniveau).
  • De Nederlandse taal heeft voor jou geen geheimen.
  • Je staat te popelen om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen in een high-paced omgeving.

Wat bieden wij? De beste start van je carrière!

  • Een uitdagende stage voor minimaal 5 maanden (4-5 dagen per week), startend in januari/februari 2027 (startdatum in overleg).
  • Stagevergoeding: Een mooie vergoeding van €450 bruto per maand (op basis van fulltime).
  • Flexibiliteit: De mogelijkheid om deels thuis te werken en je uren flexibel in te delen.
  • Toplocatie: Werken in een inspirerende omgeving in Amsterdam met bijna 120 leuke collega's, inclusief voordelige lunch en een barista voor je dagelijkse cafeïneshot.
  • Fantastische merken om je portfolio een enorme boost te geven.

Consultants work within delivery teams, turning business requirements into production-grade agentic AI solutions under the guidance of technical leads and managers. Implement context engineering pipelines, memory architectures (episodic, working, long-term), and LLM gateway configuration to support reliable, cost-efficient agent operation. Experience with classical AI/ML model integration — prediction APIs, model serving, feature pipelines. You will work with multi-disciplinary teams to embed Generative AI into SAP-centric business applications and processes, ensuring scalability, compliance, and measurable business impact. Prerequisite for RDE: Translate business processes into AI-driven workflows, integrating Agentic AI patterns and SAP s AI services to deliver scalable, intelligent, and automation-ready applications. Own end-to-end implementation, from data and model integration through solution architecture, development, testing, and deployment within SAP landscapes and customer environments. Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, data, and customer teams to drive AI adoption, optimize models in production, and continuously enhance solution quality and impact. Experience with Transforming SAP Business processes with AI & infusing Agentic AI innovations in SAP space. Strategic thinking, client-focused articulation & effective demo/communication experience. Industry & Function Roles: SAP Process AI & Innovations Expert in Supply Chain or FI or Industry Space, Nice to have - Experience with BPM & tools like Signavio Good understanding of SAP standard AI features & setup For functional & industrial roles, a fair understanding of AI technologies and how it influences business processes SAP Certifications preferred - SAP Certified Associate - Positioning SAP Business AI Solutions as part of SAP Business Suite Roles & Responsibilities: - Lead AI-driven solution design and delivery using Generative and Agentic AI to solve complex business problems, automate processes, and integrate intelligent insights into enterprise operations for measurable impact. - Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for SAP BTP and GenAI solutions. - Building technical architecture design aligning with SAP and enterprise standards. - Architect and implement Generative AI pipelines on SAP BTP, leveraging SAP AI Core, Generative AI Hub, and SAP HANA Cloud (Vector Engine + Knowledge Graph Engine). - Design and manage RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and GraphRAG workflows to improve the grounding, accuracy, and interpretability of LLM outputs. - Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) and Foundation Models (FMs) with enterprise data sources through grounding modules, vector similarity search, and semantic search. - Build Knowledge Graphs and ontologies to model enterprise domains and link contextual data for reasoning and relationship-aware GenAI applications. - Develop LangChain / LangGraph-based orchestration pipelines for prompt templating, retrieval, generation, and post-processing. - Implement data-masking, content filtering, and schema-based output parsing to ensure compliance, privacy, and structured response formats. - Collaborate with development teams using SAP Cloud Application Programming (CAP) model to embed AI capabilities into cloud-native applications. - Work with multitenant SaaS architectures ensuring secure tenant isolation and hyperscaler-agnostic deployments. - Employ chunking, embedding generation, and vector store management to enable efficient information retrieval and contextualization. - Optimize orchestration pipelines to handle prompt templating, query rewriting, and fusion techniques (e.g., Reciprocal Rank Fusion) for enhanced retrieval precision. - Lead end-to-end lifecycle of GenAI projects—from model integration and fine-tuning in AI Core to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. - Collaborate and manage cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact solutions on time and within scope. - Map business requirements to AI-powered solution architectures. - Mentor and upskill team members through knowledge-sharing sessions and best practice frameworks. - Ensure solution scalability, performance, and responsible AI usage principles are embedded throughout the development lifecycle. - Track and report project progress, ensuring strategic alignment with business objectives. Professional & Technical Skills: - Deep understanding of SAP BTP services especially AI Core, Generative AI Hub, HANA Cloud (Vector Engine and Knowledge Graph Engine). - Expertise with Large Language Models, Foundation Models, and LLM Orchestration Frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or Semantic Kernel. - Hands-on experience designing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines with embedding, chunking, and vector similarity search. - Proficiency in Knowledge Graph design, GraphRAG, and ontology modelling using SAP HANA Cloud or graph databases. - Strong grasp of data grounding, semantic enrichment, and enterprise contextualization. - Experience with schema-based output parsing, prompt templating, and prompt-engineering best practices & AI evaluation frameworks. - Familiarity with content filtering, data masking, and AI governance / compliance frameworks in enterprise environments. - Working knowledge of CAP (Cloud Application Programming model) and SAP Extension Suite for integrating GenAI into enterprise apps. - Understanding of vector stores, vector search, and semantic search APIs in HANA Cloud. - Exposure to multi-tenant SaaS architecture, hyperscaler-agnostic deployments, and MLOps pipelines for AI solutions. - Have handled deployment of large-scale SAP applications, infrastructure, data, integrations, and related systems. - Expertise in application design principles, cloud-native development, and integration within SAP ecosystem. - Familiarity with integration techniques and tools within the SAP ecosystem. - Strong understanding of application design principles and methodologies. - Ability to align AI capabilities with business objectives while ensuring scalability, responsible use, and tangible value realization. - Ability to analyze and optimize application performance. Technical Experience - End-to-end Python application development, with hands-on experience on agentic AI frameworks. - Experience in building SAP BTP GenAI application leveraging SAP AI Core & Gen AI Hub. - Experience in building APIs and ETL pipelines using Python. - Exposure to LLM (Large Language Model) integration and LangChain or similar frameworks. - Familiarity with Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent. - Proven capability in identifying and implementing BTP Business AI Services. Apply advanced analytics on knowledge graphs to drive problem-solving and actionable insights. Must have skills : AWS BigData Good to have skills : Data Engineering, Graph Databases, Neo4j Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Role Summary / Description AI Powered Tech Talent Senior Engineer role in Knowledge Engineering focused on designing, building, and leading significant workstreams for enterprise-scale Knowledge Graph, semantic layer, ontology, and AI knowledge solutions on Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role you will lead a substantial knowledge engineering scope within a large program, translates real-world business problems into scalable AI and KG solutions, guides technical direction, and contributes to thought leadership, reusable assets, and delivery standards. The role must bring relevant industry experience across domains such as BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences, applying semantic AI, knowledge graphs, LLM grounding, data pipelines, and cloud-native engineering patterns to deliver measurable client value. Key Responsibilities Engineer AWS-based knowledge engineering solutions using services such as Amazon Neptune, S3, Glue, Lambda, EMR, Redshift, Athena, OpenSearch, Bedrock, SageMaker, IAM, Step Functions, APIs, and monitoring/security services. Build graph ingestion pipelines, semantic data products, vector integrations, LLM grounding layers, APIs, and governed access patterns on AWS while improving performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency. Lead the build of Knowledge Graph solutions that transform client data architecture within a large program scope. Direct the design, development, and implementation of AI, semantic layer, ontology, taxonomy, schema, graph modeling, and knowledge curation solutions, ensuring all components work together seamlessly. Work with project leaders, delivery leads, client stakeholders, architects, data engineers, AI engineers, product teams, and domain SMEs to create standout graph-powered data and AI offerings. Develop strong client relationships, earn trust as a key advisor, and explain the business value of semantic layer, ontology, and knowledge graph solutions. Make the business case for the recommended semantic layer solution and contribute meaningfully to sales, pre-sales, estimation, proposal inputs, and solution shaping activities. Provide thought leadership on technology trends, innovation opportunities, limitations, risks, delivery concerns, and practical adoption of knowledge graphs, semantic AI, LLM grounding, RAG, and agentic systems. Design, evaluate, and maintain ontologies, schemas, standards, and reusable engineering patterns, while guiding teams on data model quality and implementation methods. Lead a team or workstream within a larger program, mentor engineers, review design/code/configuration, and guide adoption of new methodologies, model building techniques, and algorithms. Collaborate across business and technical teams to drive end-to-end delivery for the assigned scope and demonstrate value to business and technology stakeholders. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience with Knowledge Graph technologies such as RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL, OWL, graph query languages, schema design, ontology management, and KG curation. Minimum 3 years of experience in schema design, ontology management, semantic modeling, taxonomy management, metadata management, and knowledge graph curation. Minimum 3 years of experience designing and developing Knowledge Graph solutions and graph-based ML models across functional and technical workstreams. Minimum 2 years of experience implementing end-to-end data pipelines for AI applications, especially LLM-enabled or enterprise knowledge applications, with hands-on design and configuration. Minimum 4 years of experience with relational databases, object stores, graph databases such as Stardog, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune or equivalent, and vector databases. Minimum 2 years of experience leading a team or workstream within a larger program. Experience collaborating with engineering, research, product, domain, client-facing, and cross-functional teams across multiple time zones. Required Skills/ Experience Hands-on experience building AWS-based knowledge engineering solutions with Amazon Neptune, S3, Glue, Lambda, EMR, Redshift, Athena, OpenSearch, Bedrock, SageMaker, IAM, Step Functions, and cloud-native APIs/monitoring services. Strong Python experience with frameworks and tools such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, PySpark, SQL, SPARQL, SHACL, Apache Airflow, Apache NiFi, and ETL/ELT pipeline tooling. Practical knowledge of NLP and search techniques including entity extraction, entity resolution, semantic search, prompt engineering, LLM grounding, and enterprise-scale LLM applications. Ability to design and implement scalable graph ingestion, ontology/schema pipelines, semantic layers, vector search/retrieval patterns, RAG pipelines, and governed knowledge services. Strong collaboration, technical leadership, delivery ownership, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills. Good to Have Skills 2+ years of hands-on experience with cloud platforms, with AWS specialization and exposure to Azure or GCP in multi-cloud environments. AWS certifications such as Solutions Architect, Data Engineer, Machine Learning/AI Specialty, or related credentials.
